remaining_strongest_gates: Unbounded-geometric-period hereditary projective and projective-semilinear counts on arbitrary punctured covers. The proved bounded-period constants may depend on B, and full scalar coefficient order is already unrestricted. A new qualitative generating anchor has rank equal to the geometric period M, but the uniform generation, short syzygy, whole-cycle cohomology, pole comparison and actual finite-type atlas bounds O(ftr²) remain unproved. Thus the strongest quantitative counting gate is not strictly smaller.

Unrestricted alternating simple-quotient multiplicities outside the proved finite-puncture minimum weighted tower-energy criterion. Unbounded natural A_N/S_N actions retain their cost. The original-divisorial theorem retains its earlier whole-orbit criterion because hereditary original-divisorial local-pair counting is not proved.

General monolithic nonabelian crowns outside the precise faithful linear/projective/semilinear models, bounded residual outer index, quadratic simple-order comparison and the stated geometric period condition. The quotient generator term d(P) remains explicit, so these multiplicity estimates do not imply full profinite generation.
Uncovered cross-characteristic Lie families with order divisible by the ground characteristic and outside the proved faithful model/order criteria.

Full finite generation for the remaining nonprojective normal proper surface punctures and original-boundary tame quotients. Global hereditary bounds beyond the stated bounded-local-period scope and hereditary original-divisorial local pairs remain unproved.

Higher-dimensional boundary cases outside finite omitted loci, controlled exceptional centres and proved projective-model full-generation reductions; unrestricted nonnormal divisorial descent remains outside the stated closures.
auxiliary_not_movement: The explicit symplectic/orthogonal recognition and its finite-puncture global crown closure are consequences within the already counted bounded-period faithful-model enlargement. They retain d(P), the residual outer-index condition and the simple-order comparison; no independent main reduction is counted.

The rank-M generating root-stack anchor and its all-coefficient fixed-anchor Morita equivalence are qualitative auxiliary results. The coarse order has rank M² and twisted rank-r bundles become order modules of rank r/M. No uniform quantitative object atlas follows.

Exceptional Picard rigidity fixes every specified Artinian comparison divisor. Class openness applies to already effective finite-type ordinary or fixed-order Morita unit families and uses qualitative source generation only for comparison. It constructs no object family or uniform quantitative chart.

The abstract unitary scalar example is strengthened to actual unbounded geometric Brauer periods on one fixed elliptic-cone puncture. The projective images are nilpotent Heisenberg groups; no epimorphism onto the ambient simple unitary group, failure of the counting theorem or new main-gate reduction is inferred.

Separate order-incidence, balanced residual anchor, toric A-chain and noncommutative Kahn investigations remain unpromoted research notes. Reduced-stack cohomology is not substituted for coarse nonreduced-cycle cohomology. Pointwise noncommutative reduction and qualitative Serre twists do not supply a degree- and rank-uniform all-coefficient atlas.

A literal fixed-coordinate defect in the earlier A-chain finite-jet framing proposition was detected before this review: an endpoint axis branch can have w identically zero. An intrinsic-jet/adapted-coordinate repair is under exact four-party audit. The existing proof and issue record are retained; this correction is not counted as movement. No new requested outcome is declared proved.
Source checks, proof audits, compilation, visual inspection, typography repair, archive creation, saving and delivery are not movement. CP29 is verified and saved; CP30 has no archive yet.
